result.title: Empirical Bayes Flow Matching for Continuous Cryo-EM Heterogeneity
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://daiyral.github.io/Empirical-Bayes-Flow-Matching-for-Continuous-Cryo-EM-Heterogeneity/
result.summary: We address the problem of learning generative priors over high-dimensional latent variables from indirect, noisy observations, with a focus on continuous heterogeneity in cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM). In this setting, 3D atomic structures $x \in \mathbb{R}^{3N_a}$ are never directly observed and must be inferred from 2D projection images $y$ generated by a complex, non-linear forward operator. We propose Empirical Bayes Flow Matching (EB-FM), a method that learns a flow matching prior $p_θ(x)$ directly from observations using a Monte Carlo stochastic approximation Expectation-Maximization framework. EB-FM alternates between an E-step that performs approximate posterior sampling from $p_θ(x \mid y)$ via guided flow-based generation while maintaining persistent latent estimates through stochastic approximation, and an M-step that updates the flow model using these stabilized latent variables as training targets. This approach eliminates the need for pretraining on clean data and naturally accommodates non-linear forward models. We validate our method on controlled inverse problems using two-moons and MNIST data, and demonstrate its effectiveness on simulated cryo-EM data with known poses, showing that EB-FM can recover continuous distributions of protein conformations directly in atomic-coordinate space.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EB-FM，用蒙特卡洛随机近似 EM 从间接含噪的 2D 投影观测中直接学习 flow matching 先验：E 步以引导式 flow 生成近似后验采样并维护持久隐变量估计，M 步用这些稳定化的隐变量作为目标更新先验，在 toy、MNIST 与模拟 cryo-EM 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不涉视觉语言推理，但其「无干净监督、以交替估计稳定化的隐变量作训练目标」的机制，可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的监督与贡献分配问题。
